name: icy-chrome-beauty
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: a high-fashion beauty close-up portrait, tight crop, shot with crisp studio light and a cold colour grade.
· GROUND: a smooth seamless pale icy-blue backdrop, softly lit, no props.
· LIGHT: cool directional light raking across dewy skin, glossy specular highlights, wet-look sheen on lips and cheeks.
· SIGNATURE: reflective chrome and mirror-silver accents catching the light, long glossy pointed nails and metallic hardware glint.
· PALETTE: frosty cyan and steel blue washing over the skin, jet-black textures, chrome silver, cool and desaturated overall.
· CROP: the subject fills the frame and is cut by the edges, hands framing the face on a dynamic diagonal.
· TEXTURE: clean and sharp with a faint cool grain and a high-gloss finish.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
